summary: The agent now serves port 3000 directly, independently of any lifecycle runner. Application requests no longer pass through a gateway.
instructions: Open the app on port 3000 and test Chat and Settings. Remote access still requires your network password; private API key forms remain localhost-only. Pages retain automatic updates and draft protection. Local process recovery is separate at http://127.0.0.1:3001 on the host computer, with no login or application links.
